HatchPack__SitePlanHatches__Meta.Meta__Description: The site plan pack: Ordnance-Survey-style area textures for site plan drawings. One entry per pattern file in this folder.
HatchPack__SitePlanHatches__Meta.Meta__WhyAnIndex: Neither the live website nor the Flask dev server lists a directory, so a folder cannot be discovered by looking in it. This index IS the pack, and a pattern file that is not listed here does not exist as far as the editor is concerned. The same rule the Custom Scrapbook works under.

HatchPack__SitePlanHatches__Pack.Pack__Description: How this pack shows in the Patterns panel.
HatchPack__SitePlanHatches__Pack.Pack__Note: Land cover and water textures, drawn from the Ordnance Survey conventions.

HatchPack__SitePlanHatches__Patterns.Pattern__Note: Conifer and broadleaf glyphs; the woodland tag's default.
